_comment: Maps MySQL tables onto Valkey Search indexes. The translator needs the
column types because the query syntax differs per type: TAG uses
demo/mirror.py uses the same file to build FT.CREATE and copy rows in.
sortable    NUMERIC only; required to use the column in ORDER BY.
suffix_trie TEXT only; needed for LIKE '%x' and LIKE '%x%'.
separator   TAG only; defaults to \u0001 so that a scalar SQL value
containing a comma is not indexed as several tags. Set it
to ',' for columns that really do hold a delimited list.
